title: Live annotated rollouts
description: Many concurrent rollouts folded with the live annotation stream a bound protocol publishes beside each one: provisional achievements, milestones, failure modes and judge metrics as a summary layer, with the underlying step, reward, vitals and policy events still one click away.

inputs.name: stream
inputs.description: Declared rollout streams and their annotation sibling streams (synth.trace-stream-event.v1). Bind both per rollout; rows fold by rollout_id and de-duplicate by stream_id.
